zh: 设计师是在帮客户花钱。
en: A designer helps the client spend money wisely.

zh: 比如怎么装、怎么弄，选什么家具、什么东西。
en: How to fit it out, and what furniture and materials to choose.

zh: 其实设计师是帮客户花钱的。
en: In essence, a designer helps the client make those choices.

zh: 以前客户要什么，我们就给什么。
en: Before, we gave clients whatever they asked for.

zh: 现在我想让它产品化，因为我是做酒吧设计的。
en: Now I want to productize it, because I design bars.

zh: 我可能会研发很多酒吧设计方案。
en: I can develop many ready-made bar design concepts.

zh: 比如说我的想法、我的 idea、我的东西。
en: For example, I start from my ideas and what I want to make.

zh: 客户看这个设计比较好，就可以选择适合自己的。
en: The client can choose the design that suits them.

zh: 就像买产品一样，我已经生产出来了。
en: It is like buying a product that has already been prepared.

zh: 比如说我要做研发，刚弄出一个酒吧空间。
en: For example, I develop a bar-space concept.

zh: 针对300平、500平，我可以有几种风格。
en: For 300 or 500 square meters, I can prepare several styles.

zh: 比如研发一套侘寂风，或者古堡风。
en: For example, a wabi-sabi style or a castle-inspired style.

zh: 或者波西米亚风、摩洛哥风格、现代风。
en: It could also be Bohemian, Moroccan, or modern.

zh: 我自己平时就在研究，也会借助一些工具。
en: I study these styles and use tools to support the work.

zh: 以前我们自己做，成本会很高。
en: Doing all of this ourselves used to be expensive.

zh: 现在就是要借助新的AI。
en: Now we can draw on new AI capabilities.

zh: 去实现我的想法，AI它只是工具。
en: AI helps realize my ideas, but it is only a tool.

zh: 如何将你的灵感快速地实现。
en: How can your inspiration be realized quickly?

zh: 低成本地快速实现，先分两个版本。
en: We realize it quickly at low cost, starting with two versions.

zh: 如果一次性把全部功能实现，就太重了。
en: Building every feature at once would be too heavy.

zh: 我们先按1.0版本来做。
en: We begin with version 1.0.

zh: 就是脑中一瞬间的这个想法。
en: It is the idea that flashes through your mind.

zh: 快速变成能看、能选、能讲的视觉方案。
en: It quickly becomes a visual concept you can see, choose, and explain.

zh: 这里面很多东西，不能作为真正交付和落地施工。
en: Much of this cannot be final delivery or go straight into construction.

zh: 概念展示，我们快速地先展示。
en: First, we quickly show the concept.

zh: 确定真实方向后，再把方向转为真实项目。
en: Once the direction is confirmed, we turn it into a real project.

zh: 专业设计。比如我今天在某个地方。
en: Then it enters professional design; for example, I may be somewhere.

zh: 我去旅游也好，去某个地方玩也好。
en: I may be traveling or visiting a place.

zh: 平时刷短视频，或者看小红书。
en: Or I may be browsing short videos or Xiaohongshu.

zh: 看到好看的东西，我会突然有一个灵感。
en: When I see something good, an idea may suddenly appear.

zh: 这个地方能不能做成一个酒吧。
en: Could this place become a bar?

zh: 或者做成餐饮、做成会所。
en: Or perhaps a restaurant or a private club?

zh: 做成某一个空间，对不对？
en: It could become a particular kind of space.

zh: 以前可能会用手画出来。
en: In the past, I might sketch it by hand.

zh: 那个东西很考功底，也没有画得很具象化。
en: That takes skill and still may not look concrete enough.

zh: 我想在这一瞬间，把这一刻的灵感和想法
en: I want to capture the inspiration and thought of that exact moment,

zh: 然后让它还原出来。
en: Then I make it visible.

zh: 然后我就留存下来，在这个空间留存下来。
en: Then I preserve it and save it with that space.

zh: 我的想法就保存在这里了。
en: The idea is now saved here.

zh: 遇到比较适合的客户，我就把它调出来。
en: When a suitable client appears, I retrieve it.

zh: 因为它只能是一个想法，它只是一个概念。
en: It is only an idea, still just a concept.

zh: 它不能作为落地方案，真正的设计需要落地。
en: It is not a buildable plan; real design has to be executable.

zh: 给客户完美的施工呈现，或者最终的效果呈现。
en: We give the client a complete construction and final-effect presentation.

zh: 我会给你搭建一个属于自己的知识库。
en: I will build a personal knowledge base for you.

zh: 把你现有的想法、灵感和过去的经验
en: It gathers your ideas, inspiration, and past experience,

zh: 还有以前的设计图，整理成数字资产。
en: along with earlier drawings, and turns them into digital assets.

zh: 全部放到你的知识库里面。
en: Everything goes into your knowledge base.

zh: 这是你未来最值钱、最有价值的东西。
en: This may become your most valuable asset in the future.

zh: 也是你的第二大脑。
en: It becomes your second brain.

zh: 比如我们做商业，可能有应酬，也有其他事情处理。
en: In commercial work, there may be social engagements and other matters to handle.

zh: 项目处理和其他工作对接，人的大脑记忆有限。
en: With projects and other coordination, human memory is limited.

zh: 比如说，我之前想过的东西。
en: For example, things I thought about before.

zh: 它有时候会断层，就没有一个统一储存。
en: Sometimes those thoughts become disconnected without unified storage.

zh: 比如说用什么样的材质，像这样一个房间。
en: For example, which material to use in a room like this.

zh: 像现代流行的墙板，比如防撞板。
en: Such as current wall panels and impact-resistant panels.

zh: 冰火板、墙板，比如说不同的花色。
en: Fire-resistant panels, wall panels, and different finishes.

zh: 我也会做储存，因为我要去给客户。
en: I also store these choices for future client work.

zh: 比如说这个板子，客户调出来之后。
en: For example, after a client pulls up this panel option.

zh: 客户整体预算不高，空间投资预算不高。
en: The client and the space may both have a limited budget.

zh: 我就会考虑，既达到他想要的效果。
en: I consider how to achieve the effect the client wants,

zh: 又能选到好的材质，而且性价比高。
en: while choosing good materials with strong value for money.

zh: 价格不高，还能快速实现这个空间。
en: The price stays reasonable and the space can be built quickly.

zh: 这些都要储存，这就是我的材料库。
en: These choices are stored in my material library.

zh: 预算一选，立马就出来。
en: Once the option is selected, the budget appears immediately.

zh: 客户觉得好看，但这个有点贵。
en: The client may like it but feel that it is too expensive.

zh: 这个价格可以，虽然这个东西不是最完美。
en: This price works, even if the option is not perfect.

zh: 但是这个价格符合我的期待，它就有可选性。
en: But the price meets my expectations, so I have a real choice.

zh: 未来建立这样的数字库，让客户快速匹配。
en: We will build this digital library so clients can match options quickly.

zh: 然后快速选择，但客户不是专业设计师。
en: They can choose quickly, but the client is not a professional designer.

zh: 它是散的，东一下、西一下、拼一下，都是散的。
en: The ideas are scattered, one piece here and another there.

zh: 它也是散的，它想做一个什么东西。
en: It is still scattered around what the client wants to make.

zh: 他能想到，但组织不起来；设计师就是组织者。
en: The client can imagine it but cannot organize it; the designer is the organizer.

zh: 把客户的想法、我们的想法结合起来。
en: We bring together the client's ideas and our own.

zh: 结合实际情况，把它融合起来、整合起来。
en: We combine them with the real conditions and integrate everything.

zh: 其实是这样一个东西，合适，合适。
en: That is how it works, and it needs to be the right fit.

zh: 对，最好。因为这个东西说实话。
en: Yes, that is best, because to be honest about this work,

zh: 要根据我的框架确定，再结合你们去整合。
en: it must follow my framework and then be integrated with your work.

zh: 这样去建立，这样最好，因为有我的框架。
en: Building it this way is best because the framework is mine.

zh: 我的设计流程是什么。
en: I define what my design process is.

zh: 我会用文字性的文本把它写出来。
en: I write it out as a structured text document.

zh: 这样做会更好。很多客户看到的并不一定真实。
en: That works better. What many clients see is not always real.

zh: 真实性的东西，客户往往没有看到。
en: Clients often do not see the work that reflects the real substance.

zh: 像我们一样，毕竟之前是靠圈层。
en: Like us, we previously relied on our existing circle.

zh: 圈层比较多，基本都是朋友介绍。
en: Most business came through introductions from friends.

zh: 所以很多客户找不到我们。
en: So many potential clients could not find us.

zh: 找不到我们，因为我们是靠朋友介绍。
en: They could not find us because we relied on referrals from friends.

zh: 把我们的案例展示出来之后
en: Once we show our real project cases,

zh: 就是要让更多客户能够看到我们的想法。
en: The point is to let more clients see how we think.

zh: 我们能够认真地为他落地，让他能看到我们。
en: We seriously deliver the work for them and let them see us doing it.

zh: 只要你认真去做一件事情。
en: As long as you seriously commit to doing one thing well,

zh: 真实地去展示一些东西，或者为客户做一些事情。
en: Show the work truthfully and do real things for the client.

zh: 我觉得这个东西是没问题的。
en: I believe this approach can work.

zh: 这些回去以后，我们都可以去落地。
en: We can take these ideas back and put them into practice.

zh: 也可以马上开展。
en: We can start immediately.
